use default

to_quater_imaginary(value: int) -> string is
    let digits = LIST()
    let remaining mut = value

    while remaining != 0 do
        let digit = ((remaining % 4) + 4) % 4
        digits.add(digit)
        remaining = (digit - remaining) / 4
    od

    let places = LIST()
    let index mut = digits.count - 1

    while index >= 0 do
        places.add(digits[index])
        if index > 0 then
            places.add(0)
        fi
        index = index - 1
    od

    if places.count == 0 then
        places.add(0)
    fi

    return places |> map(place => "{place}") |> join("")
si

from_quater_imaginary(text: string) -> (real: int, imaginary: int) is
    let real mut = 0
    let imaginary mut = 0
    let power_real mut = 1
    let power_imaginary mut = 0
    let index mut = text.length - 1

    while index >= 0 do
        let digit = cast int(text[index]) - cast int('0')

        real = real + digit * power_real
        imaginary = imaginary + digit * power_imaginary
        let next_real = -2 * power_imaginary
        power_imaginary = 2 * power_real
        power_real = next_real
        index = index - 1
    od

    return (real, imaginary)
si

for value in 1..16 do
    write_line("{value,3} -> {to_quater_imaginary(value)}")

    let text = to_quater_imaginary(value)
